```
['create a Pangolin window with CreateWindowAndBind and set up OpenGL depth testing', 'build a ProjectionMatrix with width, height, FOV, aspect ratio, and near/far planes', 'create a ModelViewLookAt camera pointing at the origin with AxisY up', 'create a Display with SetBounds and attach a Handler3D for 3D interaction', 'run the main loop to render a coloured cube using glDrawColouredCube and FinishFrame']
```
